title: metadata-protocol + rest: the layered read (/meta/:type/:name/layers) of a name two packages hold answers as the plain read — 409 with details.candidates, never the first holder (ADR-0150 D3/D5; collects #32622 #32624)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaAUev5V62cLHhQwBi

Filing category: ① product defect with a named location (an out-of-scope finding from the #32354 build, measured on `claude/project-thread-phk4r9` plus the #32354 local head; notes `/mnt/project-files/server-seat3-p2/card-32354/step0.md`).
Part of #31527 (ADR-0150) · Refs #32201 · Refs #32354

## 维护者速读

- 改什么：按名字读元数据分层（`/meta/:type/:name/layers`）遇到多个包持有同名项而拒绝时，409 也要带 `details.candidates`，与普通读一致。
- 为什么：#32201 让普通读的 409 带上候选包，但分层读的 409 只有一句话，调用方无法知道该选哪个包。
- 风险：第一方 0 处；只是在已有的 409 上加一个字段（放宽，Clause-② yes）。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol` 中 `/layers` 的拒绝出口（`packagelessLayeredReadRefusal` 一带），对照 #32201 在普通读上的做法。
- 验证：两个包持有 d1，`GET /meta/:type/d1/layers` 应答 409，且 `details.candidates` 列出两个包。
- 需要你做的：无，归专题席派发。

## What happens

A package-scoped refusal on `/layers` answers 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT with a sentence naming the holders, but no structured `details.candidates`. This holds both for two registry holders and for the row-layer refusals #32354 adds. The plain read at the same address carries `details.candidates` since #32201. D5 says every ambiguous by-name answer names its candidates.

## Do

Carry the candidates, in the `/actions` shape, on every `/layers` refusal exit, on both transports. Pin each exit and ablate once. CONTROL: the plain read is unchanged.

Serial: after #32354, which adds row-layer `/layers` refusals.
Blocked-by: #32354
Reader who acts: the server seat the epic seat routes it to. Grade: p2 (first-party reach 0).

## Collecting card (epic seat, #32624 folded in)

Per the maintainer ruling recorded at 6829776521 on #31527 (same-family corner cards fold into one collecting card; first-party exposure 0 on each). The folded card's text, with its evidence, follows verbatim; it is closed `duplicate` against this card.

### Folded from #32624

<details><summary>#32624 as filed</summary>

domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaAUev5V62cLHhQwBi

Filing category: ① product defect with a named location, reproduced (found while measuring #32622 from the #32250 build; real RestServer, HttpDispatcher, protocol and SchemaRegistry using #32201's harness, two packages registering the dashboard `sales`; tree `claude/project-thread-2g3ujl` @ `100259e0`, which is the PR #32306 head plus #32250; probe output `/mnt/project-files/server-seat3-p2/card-32250/probe-32622-layers.txt`).
Part of #31527 (ADR-0150) · Refs #32622 · Refs #32201

## 维护者速读

- 改什么：REST 的分层读（`GET /meta/:type/:name/layers`）在两个包都注册同名项时，应和普通读、调度器的分层读一样答 409 并点名两个包，而不是静默返回第一个包的条目。
- 为什么：同一名字三扇门答法不一：普通读 409、调度器 /layers 409、REST /layers 200 给 alpha。按注册顺序悄悄选一个，违反专题红线"歧义要报告、不许猜"。
- 风险：第一方 0 处；REST /layers 200 → 409（收窄，Clause-② yes）。
- 先看：rest 包里 `/meta/:type/:name/layers` 的路由如何取条目，对照调度器路径的 `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`。
- 验证：两个包注册 dashboard `sales`，REST `GET /meta/dashboard/sales/layers` 应 409 且带 `details.candidates`。
- 需要你做的：无，归专题席派发。

## What happens (measured)

| door | answer |
|---|---|
| plain `GET /meta/dashboard/sales` (both transports) | 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT with candidates |
| dispatcher `GET /meta/dashboard/sales/layers` | 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT (candidates once #32250 lands) |
| REST `GET /meta/dashboard/sales/layers` | **200, alpha's item** |

## Do

The REST layered read resolves the name as the plain read does. Two served holders refuse 409 with `details.candidates` and never pick by order. Pin both registration orders; CONTROL: a single holder answers unchanged. Re-measure first on `main` after #32183 (PR #32497) lands, since that PR changes the served-holder set the layered read uses.

Reader who acts: the server seat the epic seat routes it to. Grade: p2 (first-party reach 0).

</details>
